message:
Hello Sam,
I hope your visa interview went well, and that you've settled into this new chapter by now. Moving must have been exhausting, but I hope you and Haju are finding your rhythm with zeal. I know things have been a juggling act lately, and it's easy to feel like you're not doing quite enough, or not doing the right things. Just know I'm sending strength and warmth, though you hardly need it. You'll do great. I hope you're healthy, homely, and happy.
Signed,
Hat
